headline: Police Commission Places Chief Pelletier on Leave, Names Wayne Mikaele Acting Chief

meeting.body: Police Commission Places Chief Pelletier on Leave, Names Wayne Mikaele Acting Chief
meeting.summary: The commission placed Chief John Pelletier on paid administrative leave during its investigation and named the deputy chief as acting chief.
meeting.recap: The commission held an executive session (a closed-door discussion) on agenda item 6A.[[0:00:02]] A motion was made to place Chief John Pelletier on paid administrative leave, effective today, while the investigation is pending.[[0:00:29]] Commissioner Santiago made the motion.[[0:00:44]] A second motion proposed naming the deputy chief as acting chief while Chief Pelletier is on leave.[[0:01:22]] Commissioner Cameron made the second motion.[[0:01:35]] The deputy chief said they would rather the commission not place Chief Pelletier on leave.[[0:02:05]] The deputy chief said they will take on duties in Chief Pelletier's absence.[[0:02:10]] The deputy chief asked for a fair administrative investigation.[[0:02:17]] The deputy chief said the previous commission did not place Chief Pelletier on leave for the CIU (criminal intelligence unit) investigation.[[0:02:24]] The chair said the deputy chief accepted the role of acting chief.[[0:02:47]] The commission approved the appointment 6 to 0.[[0:03:05]]
meeting.next: The commission's independent investigation into the chief's oversight of the criminal intelligence unit is pending. The deputy chief will take on duties as acting chief while Chief Pelletier is on leave.

moments.q: Motion to place Chief Pelletier on paid leave
"I'd rather have you not place Chief Pelletier on leave"
Acting chief vote: "Motion passes 6 to zero."
